title: Use life jugs for water rescues
description: Learn about what a life jug is from a U.S. Army Corps of Engineers park ranger and how it can save someone’s life. This public service announcement is in conjunction with the National Water Safety Program campaign “Life Jackets Worn…Nobody Mourns.” Media and members of the public are encouraged to use this video PSA.  (USACE Video by Ashley Webster)
